query: what format do I prefer for application logs

seed_memories.content: What format do I prefer for application logs: structured JSON, one event per line, with ISO-8601 timestamps in UTC, an explicit level field, and the request id propagated from the inbound trace header so we can join across services in Loki.
seed_memories.summary: Preferred application log format: JSON-per-line plus ISO-8601 plus trace id.
